item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Canvas Travel Kit
item_short_desc: Fit all of your toiletry needs and more into Rothco's Thin Blue Line Canvas Travel Kit!
description: Fit all of your toiletry needs and more into Rothco's Thin Blue Line Canvas Travel Kit! The side webbing carry handle gives you the convenience of taking it with you as you travel and the easy access zipper makes it effortless to retrieve your items. Rothco's Thin Blue Line Canvas Travel Kit Bag measures 10" x 5" x 5" and features embroidered Thin Blue Line American Flag on the side. The Thin Blue Line Shows Respect And Support For Police And Law Enforcement Officials.
